name: 友人
text: …………いくはる？
trans: ......Iku Haru?

name: はるき
trans: That's not right～～～～

name: はるき
text:
…………やだ
これ、描きなおす
trans:
......No good.
Guess I'll redo it.

name: 友人
text: えー！？
trans: Ehー!?

name: 友人
text:
ここまで描けてるのに？
もう締め切りまで時間あんまりないよ？
trans:
You've done this much, haven't you?
You know there's not much time left until 
the deadline, right?

name: はるき
trans: ──Buuut～...

name: 友人
text:
──あ、じゃあ！
これはキープしておくとか…………
trans:
──Well then!
Guess you should keep this one...

name: 羽那
text: ──はるきちゃん、最近忙しい？
trans: ──Have you been busy lately, Haruki-chan?

name: はるき
text:
……！
えっ……ううん、普通かなぁ……？
trans:
......!
Eh... N-No, not really...?

name: 羽那
text: 普通かー
trans: Not reallyー

name: はるき
text: ごめん、ぼーっとしちゃって……
trans: Sorry, I must've been spacing out...

name: はるき
text: …………壁にかかってる絵を見てたの
trans: ...I was looking at that picture hanging on the wall.

name: はるき
text:
今、学校で描いてる絵がね……
ちょっと気に入ってなくて……
trans:
I'm currently drawing one at school...
Although I'm not really happy with it...

name: 羽那
text: そうなの？
trans: Is that so?

name: はるき
text:
テーマは海で、抽象画でも風景画でも
なんでもいいんだけど──
trans:
The theme is the sea, and it could be anything, 
like abstract or landscape──

name: はるき
text: このまま完成しても、たぶん違うんだろうなって
trans:
Even if I were to finish it, it probably won't be 
the same.

name: 友人
text: ……あんたの描きたいものって？
trans: ......What do you want to draw?

name: はるき
text: なんだろう……
trans: What DO I want to draw...

name: はるき
text: わたしだけが……見た海……？
trans: Am I the only one... who saw the sea...?

name: 羽那
text: ……その絵、描き直すの？
trans: ...Are you considering redoing the picture?

name: はるき
text:
うん、そうしたいんだけど
他に何かアイディアがあるわけでもないんだよねぇ
trans:
Yeah, I'd like to, but I don't have any other idea that 
I could use.

name: はるき
text: これだって思えるようなもの……
trans: This sure is something that makes one think...

name: 羽那
text:
……？
はるきちゃん？
trans:
......?
Haruki-chan?

name: はるき
text:
あっ……ごめんね
つい考えちゃって……！
trans:
Ah... Sorry.
It's just a thought...!

name: はるき
text: どうしようかなぁ……
trans: What should I do......

name: 女性
text:
駅から行ける所に
水族館あるなんてびっくりー
trans:
I'm surprised that there's an aquarium within 
walking distance of the stationー

name: 男性
text:
癒されたなー
海の生き物いっぱいで
trans:
It was so relaxing, 
seeing it full of marine life.

name: はるき
text: 羽那ちゃん……！
trans: Hana-chan......!

name: 羽那
text:
うんっ
行ってみよっか──！
trans:
Yeah.
Let's go there!

name: 羽那
text: 綺麗だねーっ
trans: Sooo pretty.

name: はるき
text: そっか、海の中…………
trans: Like we're in the ocean...

name: はるき
text:
ふふっ……
ごめんね
trans:
Fufu...
Sorry.

name: はるき
text:
わたし、海を外から見ることしか
考えてなかったなって思って
trans:
I realize that I only had ever thought about looking 
at the ocean from the outside.

name: はるき
text: 海の中も、いいなぁ……！
trans: The inside of the ocean is nice too...!

name: 羽那
text: うんっ
trans: It is.

name: 羽那
text:
──あ
あっちに大きいエイがいるんだってー
trans:
──Oh.
Look, there's a big stingray over there.

name: はるき
text: わ、見たい見たい……！
trans: Wa, I wanna see, I wanna see...!

name: はるき
text:
ふふ～
羽那ちゃん、付き合ってくれてありがとう～
trans:
Fufu～
Thank you for coming with me, Hana-chan～

name: 羽那
text:
ううん
あたしも楽しかった──！
trans:
No problem.
I'm sooo happy to join you!

name: はるき
text: おかげで、海の絵、やる気出てきた……！
trans:
I'm really motivated to paint ocean-themed pictures 
now, thanks to this...!

name: 羽那
text: ふふっ、よかったーっ
trans: Fufu, I'm glad to hear!

name: はるき
text:
海って言うとね、やっぱり
砂浜から見た景色を思い浮かべちゃって……
trans:
When I usually think of the sea, I think of the view 
from a sandy beach...

name: はるき
text:
でも、海の中って、たくさんの魚や生き物がいて
光の感じも全然違う……
trans:
But when you look at the inside, there are so many 
lifeforms there. The light is completely different 
as well.

name: はるき
text:
あ、でも、水族館の水槽と実際の海の中も
本当は違うんだろうけど──
trans:
Ah, but I guess an aquarium and the actual ocean are 
totally different...

name: 羽那
text: うんっ
trans: Yeah.

name: はるき
text: ……本当の海の中も、いつか見てみたいなぁ
trans: ...I'd like to see the inside of the actual ocean one day.

name: 羽那
text: わっ──
trans: Wah──

name: 羽那
text:
もーっ
髪、ぐちゃぐちゃになっちゃったー
trans:
Jeeeez!
My hair is a total mess nowー

name: はるき
text:
やっぱり、上から見た海も
捨てがたいかも────
trans:
It's really hard to give up the view of the ocean from 
above──

name: はるき
text:
ふふっ……
今、思い出したんだ
trans:
Fufu......
I just remembered something.

name: はるき
text:
少し前に、海を見てた時のこと
波が光を反射して……きらきらして……
trans:
I was looking at the ocean a while ago, and the waves 
were reflecting the light... They were sparkling...

name: はるき
text: ……海って、いろんなもの見せてくれるんだね
trans: ...The sea can show us so many things.
